I don't know the plugin he is referring to, I just thought it would be a fun experience to try and make one myself. ^^
I tested my plugin and it works well, pausing the game entirely, including the bgm, and resumes it when the game has focus again (including bgm which resumes where it was paused using
AudioManager._bgmbuffer.seek
)
I believe the issue is that when he leaves the game (aka click on another window) the game pauses, but the music doesn't, which makes it go "out of sync", so I suppose the music is an important aspect of his game.
If the plugin mentioned in post #7 does that, then mine offer very little more, either way I had fun making it. ^^
